notes: Fiscal year mapping: historical FY2023–FY2025 are microchip fiscal years ended March 31 (FY ended Mar 31, 2023/2024/2025). Forecast FY2026–FY2030 are fiscal years ended March 31, 2026–2030.

EBIT proxy: operating income from the consolidated statements of operations is treated as EBIT for margin calculations. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-25-000077/mchp-20250331.htm))

D&A: 'Depreciation and amortization' from the consolidated statements of cash flows (in millions) converted to absolute dollars. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-25-000077/mchp-20250331.htm))

Capex: 'Capital expenditures' from the consolidated statements of cash flows (in millions) converted to absolute dollars. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-25-000077/mchp-20250331.htm))

NWC definition (ending value; used to derive NWC % sales): (Accounts receivable + Inventories + Other current assets - Cash and cash equivalents) - (Accounts payable + Accrued liabilities). Cash excluded; current portion of long-term debt excluded via balance-sheet offset (none in FY25 per balance sheet). Values computed from balance sheet line items in 10-K filings. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-25-000077/mchp-20250331.htm))

Forecast revenue anchoring for FY2026 uses FY26 Q1–Q3 actual net sales plus FY26 Q4 midpoint guidance from the Feb 5, 2026 8-K exhibit; growth series is computed to chain from FY2025 net sales. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1327/microchip-technology-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-of-fiscal-year-2026))

Capex base-case intensity includes the stated FY2026 capex expectation (at or below $100M), then normalizes upward gradually in later years. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-26-000008/exhibit991q3fy26.htm))

Tax rate and WACC are modeling assumptions: tax_rate set to 0.21 based on normalized effective tax rates in historical years (GAAP), while WACC is assumed (not directly disclosed). ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-25-000077/mchp-20250331.htm))

NOL: nol_balance is set to the disclosed estimated tax effect of net operating loss carryforwards ($59.3M) rather than gross NOL dollars because the filing provides tax-effect values in the disclosed table. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-25-000077/mchp-20250331.htm))

Investments: investments field left null because the prompt/schema does not define whether to include 'investments in other assets' cash outflows vs acquisitions vs equity-method investments; this input is therefore not applied to avoid double-counting. ([ir.microchip.com](https://ir.microchip.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000827054-25-000077/mchp-20250331.htm))
Current price: market price from the finance snapshot (as of 2026-03-21).

catalysts: Sustained bookings-to-revenue conversion and continued inventory normalization in distributors and direct customers.
Further margin expansion as manufacturing utilization improves and under-utilization charges decline.
Balance-sheet de-leveraging progress (net debt reduction trajectory) while sustaining disciplined capital allocation.
company_overview: Microchip Technology Incorporated designs, develops, and manufactures embedded-control semiconductor products and also generates technology licensing revenue (two-reportable line of business).
Financial reporting uses fiscal-year periods ended March 31; profitability has been cyclical and capacity utilization-dependent.
Recent communications emphasize execution of a multi-point recovery plan focused on inventory correction, manufacturing ramp, and cash/balance-sheet improvements.
current_context: FY2026 to-date performance shows sequential improvement: Q1 FY26 net sales of $1.0755B and Q2 FY26 net sales of $1.1404B, with GAAP operating income improving each quarter.
In the Dec quarter (Q3 FY26), Microchip reported net sales of $1.186B with GAAP operating income of $151.7M (12.8% operating margin) and provided FY26 Q4 guidance with midpoint net sales of $1.260B.
Management also stated FY2026 capital expenditures are expected to be at or below $100M—supporting a lower capex intensity in the near term.
investment_highlights: Base case assumes continued normalization from the FY25 trough with revenue recovery continuing through FY2030 (slowing growth rather than a peak-to-peak rebound).
Margin expansion is modeled via increasing EBIT margin as under-utilization pressure eases and gross margin moves toward normalized levels implied by improved operating results.
Reinvestment intensity is constrained early (FY26 capex guidance) with gradual normalization of capex as sales scale.
Working capital intensity is assumed to improve from the FY25 elevated level as inventory correction actions work through the system.
key_risks: Semiconductor cycle downturn or prolonged customer inventory digestion leading to lower-than-modeled revenue and margin expansion.
Execution risk in manufacturing ramp/capacity planning (utilization charges, yield issues, and cost inflation).
Working capital and cash flow volatility due to lumpy order timing and deferred/reversal of reserves.

presentation.subtitle: Microchip (MCHP): embedded recovery DCF inputs (FY ends Mar 31)
valuation_summary: DCF inputs use FY25 as the last historical base and incorporate FY26 quarterly results + Q4 guidance to anchor the start of the forecast growth series.
Terminal value is computed with a Gordon growth approach using a conservative terminal growth rate (no terminal exit multiple required).
Peer context is included primarily via forward P/E as a proxy for NTM valuation; EV/NTM revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA were not available from the cited primary/secondary sources.
